name: buzzer
title: Buzzer
description: Room lets on a satin-brass ground with black engraved caps: every page ends at the front door, an entry-phone plate with a round grille of drilled holes over Call and Email as two lit ebonite pushes and the hours engraved beneath, while the rooms list as plain numbered engraved rows with their status in words.

tokens.--font-engraved: engraved caps: site name, headings, menu, room titles, push labels, status words, hours
tokens.--font-body: running text, addresses, prices, the phone and e-mail in the slots by the pushes
tokens.--text-s: small text: addresses, facts, row descriptions, footer
tokens.--text-l: site name, room titles in rows, the line under a page title
tokens.--text-price: the price on a listing's own page
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of engraved uppercase labels
tokens.--color-bg: page background: satin brass, darkened brass at night
tokens.--color-text: the black engraving: text, links, status tabs, focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: addresses, dates, row numbers, hours label
tokens.--color-accent: link underlines and the current menu mark
tokens.--color-brush: fine brushing lines on the ground and the plate
tokens.--color-groove: engraved rules: masthead, rows, grille ring, tables
tokens.--color-sheen: light catch under engraved text, grooves and screws (shadow at night)
tokens.--color-shade: shadows of the plates and pushes, recess of the phone and e-mail slots
tokens.--color-plate: the entry-phone plate, the nameplate and the skip link
tokens.--color-plate-edge: plate edges, screw heads, push bezels, photo frames
tokens.--color-hole: the drilled holes of the grille
tokens.--color-ebonite: the black pushes and the pip by the masthead phone
tokens.--color-ebonite-hi: highlight on the face of each push
tokens.--color-lamp: the lit ring round each push and the pip, inner focus ring
tokens.--color-glow: glow spilling from the lit rings
tokens.--color-slot: the recessed slots by the pushes that hold the phone and e-mail
tokens.--page-width: maximum width of masthead, page and footer
tokens.--door-width: width of the door column on wide screens
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the plate, push hit areas, photos, code
